research_notes: Current workload has exercised both reasoning synthesis and persistent I/O rather than one homogeneous operation.
This supports the W3 mixed-profile label.
A future reasoning-heavy profile should reduce write frequency while retaining durable periodic checkpoints.
A future I/O-heavy profile can stress checkpoint latency more explicitly.
If both support similar boundaries, confidence in a universal cap increases.
If they diverge, cap/policy must respect the lower-risk profile result.
